components.title: Justification of any overage
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Justification of any overage in the formulation(s) described in P1. CONTRACT: Reference P1 composition; state overage %/amount, scientific/regulatory rationale, and impact on assay/content uniformity. PRESENTATION: Plain text from source.
